why: ChatGPT's answer says an RV off-grid system takes panels, a lithium battery, an MPPT controller and an inverter, and it gives a tiered sizing table from weekend use to full-time living. It only carded two 400 W 12 V starter kits, but whether a set works depends on daily watt-hours, MPPT voltage and current limits versus the array, battery voltage (12 V vs 48 V) and inverter surge, so the page should compare a weekend tier and a full-time tier as separate single-cart sets.
